CREATE TABLE step_samples (timestamp INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, steps INTEGER NOT NULL, calories INTEGER NOT NULL, distance INTEGER NOT NULL, heart_rate INTEGER, spo2 INTEGER, resting_heart_rate INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE sleep_segments (start INTEGER NOT NULL, end INTEGER NOT NULL, type INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (start, type))
CREATE TABLE device (address TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, product_model TEXT, software_version TEXT, last_sync INTEGER)
ALTER TABLE sleep_segments ADD COLUMN stage TEXT

CREATE TABLE workouts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, workout_number INTEGER NOT NULL, start INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, end INTEGER NOT NULL, sport_type INTEGER NOT NULL, sport_name TEXT NOT NULL, duration INTEGER NOT NULL, distance INTEGER NOT NULL, calories INTEGER NOT NULL, avg_hr INTEGER, max_hr INTEGER, steps INTEGER NOT NULL, summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1)
CREATE TABLE workout_points (workout_id INTEGER NOT NULL, ts INTEGER NOT NULL, lat REAL, lon REAL, alt REAL, hr INTEGER)
CREATE INDEX workout_points_by_workout ON workout_points (workout_id, ts)
ALTER TABLE step_samples ADD COLUMN rev INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE sleep_segments ADD COLUMN rev INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE workouts ADD COLUMN rev INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
UPDATE step_samples SET rev = rowid
UPDATE sleep_segments SET rev = rowid
UPDATE workouts SET rev = id
CREATE TABLE cloud_cursor (tbl TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, seq INTEGER NOT NULL, uploaded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

INSERT INTO cloud_cursor (tbl, seq) VALUES ('step_samples', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(rev), 0) FROM step_samples)), ('sleep_segments', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(rev), 0) FROM sleep_segments)), ('workouts', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(rev), 0) FROM workouts))
CREATE TABLE cloud_state (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX step_samples_by_rev ON step_samples (rev)
CREATE INDEX sleep_segments_by_rev ON sleep_segments (rev)
CREATE INDEX workouts_by_rev ON workouts (rev)

CREATE TRIGGER step_samples_rev_insert AFTER INSERT ON step_samples BEGIN UPDATE cloud_cursor SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE tbl = 'step_samples'; UPDATE step_samples SET rev = (SELECT seq FROM cloud_cursor WHERE tbl = 'step_samples') WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER step_samples_rev_update AFTER UPDATE ON step_samples WHEN NEW.rev = OLD.rev BEGIN UPDATE cloud_cursor SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE tbl = 'step_samples'; UPDATE step_samples SET rev = (SELECT seq FROM cloud_cursor WHERE tbl = 'step_samples') WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER sleep_segments_rev_insert AFTER INSERT ON sleep_segments BEGIN UPDATE cloud_cursor SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE tbl = 'sleep_segments'; UPDATE sleep_segments SET rev = (SELECT seq FROM cloud_cursor WHERE tbl = 'sleep_segments') WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER sleep_segments_rev_update AFTER UPDATE ON sleep_segments WHEN NEW.rev = OLD.rev BEGIN UPDATE cloud_cursor SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE tbl = 'sleep_segments'; UPDATE sleep_segments SET rev = (SELECT seq FROM cloud_cursor WHERE tbl = 'sleep_segments') WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER workouts_rev_insert AFTER INSERT ON workouts BEGIN UPDATE cloud_cursor SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE tbl = 'workouts'; UPDATE workouts SET rev = (SELECT seq FROM cloud_cursor WHERE tbl = 'workouts') WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END

CREATE TRIGGER workouts_rev_update AFTER UPDATE ON workouts WHEN NEW.rev = OLD.rev BEGIN UPDATE cloud_cursor SET seq = seq + 1 WHERE tbl = 'workouts'; UPDATE workouts SET rev = (SELECT seq FROM cloud_cursor WHERE tbl = 'workouts') WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
CREATE TABLE diet_day (date TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, meals_json TEXT NOT NULL, goals_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, pushed_at INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE body_metrics (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE cycle_periods (start TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, end TEXT, modified INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE cycle_days (day TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, flow INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cramps INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, modified INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE health_metrics (type TEXT NOT NULL, ts INTEGER NOT NULL, last_ts INTEGER NOT NULL, value REAL, values_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (type, ts))
CREATE INDEX health_metrics_by_ts ON health_metrics (ts)

CREATE TABLE health_metric_status (type TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, dict_class INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, supported INTEGER NOT NULL, gate TEXT NOT NULL, checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL, synced_at INTEGER, rows_added INTEGER, note TEXT)
CREATE TABLE sleep_scores (start INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, end INTEGER NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL, efficiency INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE rri_samples (ts_ms INTEGER PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, rri INTEGER NOT NULL, sqi INTEGER)
